comments.author: @RealLifeFilesDoc
comments.text: "It’s heartbreaking to hear that cyclones and free-roaming goats are threatening the ancient Dragon’s Blood trees [17:32]. I hope global conservation efforts can help preserve this irreplaceable island before it's too late."

replies.author: @reallifeincountries
replies.text: Socotra's unique biodiversity is so precious, and those Dragon's Blood trees are truly irreplaceable! 🌲 🪵 Preservation efforts can't come soon enough. Thanks for sharing such a thoughtful comment!"
